$comment: Repositories the library knows about. Each source is read from GitHub for a generator.json or generator-library.json; the overlay fills in what the repo does not publish yet. Once a repo carries its own manifest, shrink or drop its overlay here.

sources.note: Fork of ianbauters/terrain-press. The committed site/ folder is the whole static app, so the offline copy comes straight from the repository tree.

overlay.name: Terrain Press
overlay.summary: Turn real NASA elevation data into 3D-printable ornaments and jigsaw puzzles.
overlay.description: Pick a place on Earth, the Moon, Mars, Mercury, Ceres, Vesta, Venus, Pluto or the gas giants, choose a shape and a size, and download print-ready STL and 3MF files. Everything is computed in the browser from real spacecraft measurements.

distributions.label: Install offline copy
distributions.notes: Downloads the site/ folder with the bundled elevation data (about 300 MB).

sources.note: Vostok Labs monorepo: ten web generators under apps/ plus MakerWorld listings. The whole set also ships as a private Windows desktop build.

generators.name: Image to Clicker
generators.summary: Turn any image, logo, or custom text into a clicker fidget.

generators.name: Fridge Magnet & Fidget Slider
generators.summary: Turn any image into a printable fridge magnet, or a two-piece magnetic fidget slider that clicks as it slides.

generators.name: Custom Keycap Generator
generators.summary: Custom keycaps with icons, logos, or letters.

generators.name: Name Keychain Generator
generators.summary: Personalized plate-style name keychains with live font preview, pixel and script styles, multi-language, and 1 to 3 colour layers.

generators.name: House & Office Number Generator
generators.summary: Type a number, pick a plate, print a house or office sign that fits your door.

generators.name: Pen Topper Generator
generators.summary: Personalised pen and pencil toppers: any name, 257 fonts, 1,487 symbols, and a socket sized to the pen you own.

generators.name: Fold-Up Box Generator
generators.summary: Set the size, pick a structure, print it flat as one thin grooved sheet, then fold it into a box.

generators.name: Keychain Carabiner Set
generators.summary: A snap-hook clip and a chain to hang your keys or a fidget on, printed flat in one job.

generators.name: Laser Studio
generators.summary: 58 laser templates (keychains, pet tags, ornaments, QR stands, coasters and signs) with fonts, symbols and pattern fills, exported as SVG.

generators.name: Laser Box
generators.summary: Pick a box, set its size and material, add a pattern, download a cut file that fits together.

generators.name: Vostok Labs Standalone (Windows)
generators.summary: All ten Vostok Labs web generators bundled as one offline Windows desktop app, including the LED Lightbox generator.

distributions.label: Install Windows app
distributions.notes: Published by the repository's Windows release workflow.

generators.name: Large Customizable Box
generators.summary: Large customizable print-in-place box. No hardware or screws required.

generators.name: Customizable Rugged Box
generators.summary: Super customizable rugged box. Print in place, no extra hardware.

generators.name: Washer & Spacer Generator
generators.summary: Customizable washer and spacer generator. Set ID, OD, and thickness.

generators.name: Desk Headphone Hook
generators.summary: Adjustable desk headphone hook. Parametric to fit any desk thickness.

generators.name: Edge Mount Device Dock
generators.summary: Customizable edge mount dock for phones, e-readers and tablets.

generators.name: Screw-On Power Strip Holder
generators.summary: Customizable screw-on power strip holder. Mount a strip securely under a desk.

sources.note: The exe distribution needs the desktop-v* releases that the repository's Windows workflow publishes. A GitHub token is needed in Settings while the repository is private.

overlay.name: Marble Run Maker
overlay.summary: Offline 16 mm marble run builder with bundled Plain and Japandi high-resolution 3MF profiles.
overlay.description: A private, customized local mirror of the 16 mm Marble Run Builder, packaged with an Electron Windows wrapper. Runs without an account, cloud hosting or Internet access.

distributions.label: Install offline copy
distributions.notes: The mirrored site as committed; large 3MF profiles stored with Git LFS are not included.

sources.note: Fork of andymai/gridfinity-layout-tool. The desktop workflow publishes desktop-v* releases with an NSIS installer. Bin Designer and Baseplate Generator are listed separately so they can be found on their own.

generators.name: Gridfinity Layout Tool
generators.summary: Plan and design Gridfinity drawer organizer layouts for 3D printing, with a layout planner, 3D preview and print list.

distributions.label: Install Windows app
distributions.notes: Offline installer with bundled WebView2. Cloud sharing and sign-in are unavailable offline.

generators.name: Gridfinity Bin Designer
generators.summary: Parametric Gridfinity bin generator with STL export.

generators.name: Gridfinity Baseplate Generator
generators.summary: 3D-printable Gridfinity baseplates with automatic splitting and STL, STEP and 3MF export.

sources.note: Fork of bruceborrett/easy-enclosure (Angular + JSCAD). No desktop build; offline use goes through WebMirror.

overlay.name: Easy Enclosure
overlay.summary: Design 3D-printable enclosures for electronics with snap-fit lids, PCB standoffs and cable clamps; exports STL and STEP.

sources.note: The mirroring tool itself, so it can be installed from the library, from the build-* releases its workflow publishes.

overlay.name: WebMirror
overlay.summary: Save public static websites and serve them locally. The library uses it to mirror web generators for offline use.
